mentions.name: Soul Crystal
mentions.description: A revived, playable browser version of Soul Crystal, a 1992 German graphic/text adventure. Based on reverse engineering work, it adds an English translation, reimagined HD graphics, and voiced cutscenes, with the source available on GitHub.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've revived Soul Crystal, a German graphic/text adventure from 1992, based on reverse engineering work I started back in 2006. Over the past two weeks, I've turned it into a playable browser game with English translation, reimagined HD graphics, and voiced cutscenes.

Play: https://s-macke.github.io/Soul-Crystal/

Source: https://github.com/s-macke/Soul-Crystal
